description: A published reference fixture for implementers of the rules format (docs/rules-format.md, "Verify your client"). A synthetic library (versions.generator; nothing real) is given to the lineup planner at first setup, and the days of every switched-on channel are built from the lineup it plans. snapshot is the planner's input: items, series and collections as the engine reads them; the library's other kinds (videos, music videos) and every item with no runtime are left out, as the app's own snapshot leaves them out. lineup is what the planner chose: per channel its id, number, source, state and seed (decimal text), and for a starter or custom channel its rules in the exact text RulesWriter writes. A leftovers channel has no rules: its pool is the engine's, from the other channels. days[i] is the broadcast day i of every switched-on channel: the day that holds inputs.nowMs is day 0. A channel's blocks tile [epochStartMs, epochEndMs) and are half-open; a block is {startMs, endMs, itemId, mediaStartOffsetMs} for a program or {startMs, endMs, slate: true}. Every millisecond count is decimal text. A mismatch of versions (catalog, kid hold, grown-up hold, curation) means the files are not comparable.
